<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Raw Form</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "brutal-form-raw",
    "title": "Raw Form",
    "summary": "Unstyled-looking inputs with thick focus outlines.",
    "description": "Unstyled-looking inputs with thick focus outlines.",
    "theme": "brutalism-y2k",
    "categories": ["brutalism", "y2k"],
    "tags": ["brutalism", "raw", "form", "raw", "focus", "input"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2000s",
    "difficulty": "beginner",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Deliberately raw does not mean inaccessible: keep contrast, focus states, and hit areas intact.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--hl", "description": "Focus colour", "default": "#ffe600" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Retune the palette via the custom properties", "Slow the motion for an ambient version"],
    "ai_usage": "Brutalist forms. Exaggerated focus outlines fit the aesthetic and improve accessibility at the same time — a rare free win."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { width: 260px; background: #fff; border: 4px solid #0b0d12; padding: 1rem; font-family: "Courier New", monospace; color: #0b0d12; }
    .fx label { display: block; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: .75rem; margin-bottom: .3rem; }
    .fx input { width: 100%; padding: .5rem; border: 2px solid #0b0d12; font: inherit; margin-bottom: .9rem; }
    .fx input:focus { outline: 4px solid #ffe600; outline-offset: 0; }
    .fx button { width: 100%; padding: .6rem; border: 3px solid #0b0d12; background: #ffe600; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
    .fx button:active { transform: translate(3px, 3px); }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form class="fx"><label for="e">Email</label><input id="e" type="email" /><button type="button">SUBMIT</button></form>
</body>
</html>
